paper.abstract_en: We construct four families of spacetime metrics depending on a single variable for a broad class of $D$-dimensional gravitational theories coupled to scalar and Abelian gauge fields. As applications of the general formalism, we derive one-variable solutions of ungauged $\mathcal{N}=2$, $D=4$ supergravity coupled to vector multiplets. We also obtain explicit solutions for a consistent truncation of $\mathcal{N}=8$, $D=4$ supergravity, as well as for theories whose scalar fields parametrize the symmetric coset manifolds $SL(N,\mathbb{R})/SO(N,\mathbb{R})$. In all cases, the geometry of the scalar manifold plays a central role in determining the structure of the resulting solutions with nontrivial scalar and gauge field configurations.
